computers.lead: Full step-by-step help for computers is on the way. For now, here’s the short version — and staff can get you set up in a minute.

facts.v: Join [[public Wi‑Fi network name|CPL-Public]]. No password. Accept the terms page that opens.
Log in with [[login method|your library card number and PIN]], or ask for a guest pass.
Sessions last [[computer session length|2 hours]] and can be extended if no one’s waiting.
Everything is erased when you log out.[[confirm computers wipe on logout|]] Save to email or a USB drive.
